proposed_capability: Classify task and domain clearance evidence before ranking work in the installed Active Portraits handoff.
player_save_control_impact: Existing frame and portrait authority gate one submission. No cancellation, save changes, desktop input, game installation or EA effects in this sprint.
expected_outcome: Zero samples hold evaluation. Partial evidence holds this portrait tier. Enough scoped distinct samples and active Sim time permit evaluation under the existing player and queue gates. Other qualified portraits can continue.
negative_tests: A missing, replayed, cross-task or stale capture cannot admit a task or clear its domain tier.
Elapsed time without enough samples and frequent samples without enough active Sim time both hold evaluation.
Evidence that loses qualification on the second frame cannot trigger a portrait switch or native queue mutation.
rollback_path: Revert the feature merge. The existing ownership-scoped package can be uninstalled after game close.
unresolved_unknowns: Exact-build Windows EA sources, registration and a live queue/portrait/rollback trial under #171.
